description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcel in Wariyapola D/S Division and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership/possession/interest in specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and property ownership claims across multiple districts, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land acquisition matters.
